title: Raise live-boundary coverage across protocol surfaces
summary: Grow opt-in live coverage for real daemon, CLI, MCP subprocess, A2A restart, and local model boundaries while keeping default CI fast and deterministic.
expectedFailureModes: Live tests silently become environment-specific and fail on contributor machines without clear skip messages.
A live test depends on external credentials and gets mistaken for a default CI requirement.
The test ratio improves numerically while the riskiest surfaces remain mock-only.
humanEscalation: Credentials for paid or rate-limited external APIs
nextAction: Add a live coverage matrix that maps each protocol surface to mock and live tests before adding more tests.
